Types of Complications: Neurological: Hypertension or hypotension, hemorrhage, stroke, MI, thrombosis, nerve palsy
Nonneurological: Infection, arterial restenosis, and death

Statistics: 3.2% risk of stroke or death in CREST study symtomatic patients

Other Observations: Cranial nerve injury rate of 5.1% in ECST
Incidence of perioperative MI was 0.3% in NASCET

Miscellaneous Observations: Reports of prior neurological evaluations show reduced stroke/death rates
Recent studies show lower perioperative stroke risk but surgical risks remain high at 7.11% for stroke or death
